title: David & Goliath — a nova in two voices

format.note: 9:16. A 3:4 window (bars top and bottom) until ignition; the frame opens to the full 9:16 in the dark

shots.purpose: Open in the abyss; something immense is near
shots.action: From black, faint stars; a crimson limb rises from the bottom of frame, plumes lifting; slow upward drift as the basses begin
shots.framing: Extreme close to the giant's horizon, wide lens, horizon low in frame

shots.purpose: Introduce GOLIATH: overwhelming mass and heat
shots.action: Pull back to reveal the boiling red giant, convection cells the size of suns, prominences at the limb; slow rotation
shots.framing: Three-quarter disk, off-centre left, fills 80% of frame height

shots.action: A single piercing blue-white point in black; slow push reveals an Earth-sized sphere, smooth and ferocious, faint blue magnetic filaments
shots.framing: Starts as a point at frame centre-right; ends medium close

shots.purpose: First sight: the figure in profile, looking away; perpendicular to us
shots.action: Marble figure on black, slowly turning its gaze toward us (see INSERTS)
shots.framing: Locked: the whole statue piece small in the black (M05 composition); only the figure turns

shots.purpose: Scale and attraction: the giant leans toward the dwarf
shots.action: Wide system view; the giant swollen into a teardrop toward a tiny bright speck; ice-blue scientific lines draw on: orbit, Roche figure-eight, L1
shots.framing: Giant left third (huge), dwarf right, orbital plane slightly below eye line

shots.action: Match cut: the same figure-eight drawn in iron-gall ink on parchment with mirror-script notes, the pen line completing
shots.framing: Flat lay of a notebook page, slight drift

shots.action: Close on the giant's L1 tip: the surface lifts into a tongue of plasma stretching toward the off-screen dwarf whose light rakes it blue-white
shots.framing: Low angle along the stretching tongue

shots.purpose: The profile again, closer: lips and jaw in hard light
shots.action: Marble figure on black, slowly turning its gaze toward us (see INSERTS)
shots.framing: Locked: the whole statue piece small in the black (M05 composition); only the figure turns

shots.purpose: Vast sheets of incandescent matter rip from the giant
shots.action: A river of fire pours through L1 and arcs across space toward the dwarf; camera tracks alongside the stream
shots.framing: Medium-wide, stream crossing frame left to right

shots.purpose: Orbital parabolas: the stolen matter falls
shots.action: Ride with a clump along its ballistic arc as Coriolis bends it around the dwarf; a gold dashed trajectory with tick marks draws ahead of it
shots.framing: Chase camera above the orbital plane

shots.purpose: Head and neck against the void, the aura behind
shots.action: Marble figure on black, slowly turning its gaze toward us (see INSERTS)
shots.framing: Locked: the whole statue piece small in the black (M05 composition); only the figure turns

shots.action: Where the stream slams the forming disk: shock, sparks, turbulent plasma; blue magnetic filaments channel matter
Red-chalk study: a hand carrying a flame in a fennel stalk; a faint arc links a large circle to a small one
shots.framing: Close on the drawing, the flame catching warm light

shots.purpose: The carved eye, beginning to come round
shots.action: Marble figure on black, slowly turning its gaze toward us (see INSERTS)
shots.framing: Locked: the whole statue piece small in the black (M05 composition); only the figure turns

shots.action: The giant's torn L1 tip pouring matter into space
shots.framing: Medium close on the tip, stream leaving frame right

shots.purpose: Gravitational terror: the vortex engulfs the dwarf
shots.action: Camera sinks into the disk plane; crimson and gold spirals rush past on both sides; the dwarf blazes at the centre, swallowed
shots.framing: Wide-angle inside the vortex, dwarf centre frame

shots.purpose: Small in the black: head and shoulders, light from above
shots.action: Marble figure on black, slowly turning its gaze toward us (see INSERTS)
shots.framing: Locked: the whole statue piece small in the black (M05 composition); only the figure turns

shots.action: Hydrogen nuclei rain onto a compressed layer, jittering, glowing, pressing together

shots.purpose: Compression: the hydrogen layer piles up
shots.action: The dwarf surface under a thickening glowing ocean of accreted gas
Gold-crimson plasma convulsing
Wide: the giant visibly feeding the disk

shots.purpose: Leonardo's water vortex rhymes with the disk
shots.action: Ink study of a swirling deluge vortex drawing itself

shots.purpose: The real vortex answers the drawing
shots.action: Top-down accretion spiral, same rotation as the ink
Glowing nuclei arranged in the CNO cycle, protons striking carbon
Blue filaments twisting and tightening around a hot core
The surface brightens; small flares flicker

The vortex from above spins faster; the dwarf brightens; silence in the tutti, then tremolo

shots.purpose: The held breath: a slow push on the three-quarter face
shots.action: Marble figure on black, slowly turning its gaze toward us (see INSERTS)
shots.framing: Locked: the whole statue piece small in the black (M05 composition); only the figure turns

shots.action: Hard cut on the strike: wide system, disk flares, stream whips
Inner disk white-hot around the engulfed dwarf

shots.purpose: Between strikes: the face, hard light
shots.action: Marble figure on black, slowly turning its gaze toward us (see INSERTS)
shots.framing: Locked: the whole statue piece small in the black (M05 composition); only the figure turns

shots.action: Dwarf surface layer glowing, blue filaments snapping
Nuclei crushed together; fusion sparks multiplying

shots.purpose: Both eyes now, almost upon us
shots.action: Marble figure on black, slowly turning its gaze toward us (see INSERTS)
shots.framing: Locked: the whole statue piece small in the black (M05 composition); only the figure turns

shots.purpose: Strike 5 and the final tremolo: inevitability
shots.action: Extreme close on the surface; light bends; the glow climbs, then the whole image is drawn inward to a single point and swallowed; nothing is left but black at the cut

shots.purpose: Ignition: thermonuclear runaway, felt not seen
shots.action: Black. No flash: the picture is gone and the pressure wave and the roar carry the climax. At most a dying afterimage of the point

shots.purpose: The eruption emerges from the dark
shots.action: Out of black a white-gold point swells into a seething spherical eruption, the surrounding space still black; never a full-frame white-out
Wide: the incandescent sphere swallows the disk and races toward the giant, whose facing hemisphere flares gold
The shock front sweeps through camera; refraction, debris streaks; peak of the Doppler roar
The decelerating shell fractures into golden filaments as the roar descends
The fractured golden shell, immense, expanding; Rayleigh-Taylor fingers and knots; the pair small inside
Goliath scarred: facing hemisphere stripped and burning, embers drifting, envelope torn
The tiny core endures, still blazing; the shell recedes; a thin thread of matter begins to flow again
Final wide: the system inside a perfect ring of the shell
Dissolve to an ink drawing of the same rings with the tiny centre point; mirror script: il sole nõ si move

shots.purpose: Seen from Earth: a new star
shots.action: The Milky Way arches up from a dark, unlit horizon (no light pollution: the galactic core, dust lanes, airglow); stillness; then, silently, a new star appears where there was none. The film ends on it
shots.framing: Locked-off night sky, 9:16, horizon low, galactic core rising vertically

shots.purpose: The gaze: after the night sky, the figure looks straight into the lens, staring into you
shots.action: Marble figure on black, the 90-degree turn complete; NOVA: <figure> beneath

overlays.purpose: Match dissolve: real rings become ink rings
